title: Signal: Archive extraction via $zip->extractTo(payload) (php) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the $zip->extractTo(payload) call in php code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any $zip->extractTo(payload) call matches, including extraction of trusted archives. Archive trust needs human review.
fpNotes: Extracting bundled, trusted archives is the common false positive.
